q: Which dinosaur's name means "tyrant lizard king"?
funFact: Some T. rex teeth were as long as a banana.

q: What did Stegosaurus have along its back?
funFact: Stegosaurus also swung sharp spikes on its tail.

q: Which of these dinosaurs ate only plants?
funFact: Triceratops ground up tough plants with hundreds of teeth.

q: About how long ago did the last big dinosaurs disappear?
funFact: A huge asteroid smashed into Earth around that time.

q: Which animals alive today came from dinosaurs?
funFact: Scientists say birds really are living dinosaurs.

q: Autoroute 20 turns into which highway in Ontario?
funFact: The 401 is one of the busiest highways in North America.

q: Brockville sits beside which famous group of islands?
funFact: There are actually more than 1,800 islands out there.

q: What is a hedge maze made of?
funFact: Gardeners clip the hedges so the walls stay thick and green.

q: How are Ribfest ribs usually cooked?
funFact: Pitmasters can smoke their ribs for many hours.

q: How many provinces does our race drive through?
funFact: Ontario and Québec are Canada's two biggest provinces by people.
